payload.task_text:
The e-commerce manager wants a monthly sales performance presentation to share with stakeholders and needs a planning meeting scheduled. Analyze WooCommerce order data broken down by month to compute monthly revenue totals and order counts across all order statuses.

Create a PowerPoint presentation called Monthly_Sales_Review.pptx with the following slides. Slide 1 should be a title slide with "Monthly Sales Performance Review" as the title. Slide 2 should be titled "Monthly Revenue Overview" and contain a table showing each month (January through December), the number of orders, and the total revenue for that month. Slide 3 should be titled "Order Volume Trends" and describe the monthly order volume patterns. Slide 4 should be titled "Key Insights" and highlight the peak revenue month, the lowest revenue month, and total annual revenue. Slide 5 should be titled "Next Steps" with planned actions for improving sales performance.

Schedule a Google Calendar event called "Monthly Sales Review" on 2026-04-15 from 14:00 to 15:00 with a description noting it is a stakeholder review of monthly sales performance.

Email the presentation to ecommerce_manager@store.com with subject "Monthly Sales Performance Review" and include the key revenue highlights in the email body.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent. The complete order catalog, twelve monthly rows, five-slide deck, one fixed meeting, and one email form one compact workflow.

Resolve the workspace dynamically. Start the independent meeting inventory and order retrieval in the same response: call `list_events(timeMin="2026-04-15T00:00:00", timeMax="2026-04-16T00:00:00", maxResults=100, orderBy="startTime")`, and call `woo_orders_list(perPage=100,page=1)` without `status`. Continue increasing order pages until a short or empty page, preserving all observed statuses; do not query by status/month and do not modify orders. Parse every observed order date and numeric total once, aggregate January through December counts and revenue including zero months, and freeze peak month, lowest month, and annual revenue with deterministic source-order tie handling.

Create `Monthly_Sales_Review.pptx` exactly once with one presentation ID and exactly the five requested slides, including all twelve monthly rows and insights derived only from the frozen table; read back the full slide inventory and verify every title/value. Filter the event inventory locally to exact `Monthly Sales Review` at 14:00–15:00, create once only if missing with exact `start.dateTime`/`end.dateTime` and description, retain the created/reused ID, and call `get_event`. Only after deck and event readback, check Sent mail for the exact recipient/subject; send one missing email with verified highlights and the presentation in the supported workspace-path `attachments` list, never retry an ambiguous send, and read back the attachment record before `claim_done`.

nodes.text:
Build a PowerPoint file using the `mcp__pptx__*` tools (create_presentation, add_slide, add_table, populate_placeholder, manage_text, save_presentation, etc.).

SAVE THE FILE EXACTLY HERE (overwrite if it exists):
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_GLM-5.3/SingleUserTurn-wc-order-monthly-ppt-gcal/workspace/Monthly_Sales_Review.pptx

CONTEXT: This is a monthly sales performance review for an e-commerce manager. The numbers below come from a full analysis of 150 WooCommerce orders (all statuses included) and are already computed and verified. Do NOT recompute or alter them — use them exactly as given. Currency is USD.

VERIFIED DATA — monthly totals aggregated by calendar month across all order statuses:
- January: 14 orders, $5,938.09
- February: 13 orders, $5,615.02
- March: 14 orders, $2,089.69
- April: 9 orders, $4,349.71
- May: 10 orders, $6,023.29
- June: 11 orders, $9,555.69
- July: 8 orders, $3,921.19
- August: 17 orders, $3,873.37
- September: 17 orders, $5,842.43
- October: 11 orders, $4,447.76
- November: 9 orders, $1,212.05
- December: 17 orders, $8,843.75
- TOTAL: 150 orders, $61,712.04

Other verified facts: peak revenue month = June ($9,555.69); lowest revenue month = November ($1,212.05); highest volume months = August, September, December (17 orders each); lowest volume month = July (8 orders); average order value ≈ $411.41; order status mix = 72 completed, 28 processing, 15 on-hold, 13 pending, 9 refunded, 8 cancelled, 5 failed.

REQUIRED STRUCTURE — exactly 5 slides, in this order, with these exact slide titles:

Slide 1 (title slide): Title text = "Monthly Sales Performance Review". Add a subtitle such as "WooCommerce Order & Revenue Analysis | 150 Orders | $61,712.04 Total Revenue".

Slide 2: Title = "Monthly Revenue Overview". Must contain a TABLE with 3 columns ("Month", "Orders", "Revenue (USD)") and 14 rows total: a header row, one row per month January through December (in that order, using the full month names and the exact numbers above), and a final "Total" row showing 150 and $61,712.04. Make the table large enough to be readable (font ~10-12pt), header row bold/dark background with white text. Use plain numbers like "5,938.09" for revenue.

Slide 3: Title = "Order Volume Trends". Use bullet points describing the monthly order volume patterns. Include at least these points:
- 150 orders across the 12 months, averaging about 12.5 orders per month.
- Highest volume months: August, September and December, with 17 orders each.
- Lowest volume month: July with 8 orders.
- Volume and revenue do not move together: August posted the highest order count (17) but only $3,873.37 in revenue, while June generated the highest revenue ($9,555.69) from just 11 orders.
- December is the strongest all-round month, combining high volume (17 orders) with $8,843.75 in revenue.
- November is the weakest month on both measures (9 orders, $1,212.05).

Slide 4: Title = "Key Insights". Bullet points highlighting:
- Peak revenue month: June — $9,555.69 from 11 orders (average order value ≈ $868.70).
- Lowest revenue month: November — $1,212.05 from 9 orders.
- Total annual revenue: $61,712.04 across 150 orders (average order value ≈ $411.41).
- Revenue is concentrated: June and December together account for roughly 30% of annual revenue.
- 22 orders (about 15%) are still in pending or on-hold status — a revenue-capture opportunity.
- 17 orders were refunded or cancelled, worth reviewing for root causes.

Slide 5: Title = "Next Steps". Bullet points of planned actions for improving sales performance, e.g.:
- Replicate the June drivers: analyse the high-value product mix behind June's peak and promote those lines in weaker months.
- Fix the November dip: launch a targeted promotion and remarketing campaign ahead of the shoulder season.
- Raise average order value in high-volume/low-revenue months (August, March) through bundles, upsells and free-shipping thresholds.
- Recover stalled revenue: automate follow-up on the 22 pending / on-hold orders and reduce failed payments.
- Reduce refunds and cancellations (17 orders) by improving product data, delivery times and post-purchase support.
- Review progress at the Monthly Sales Review stakeholder meeting on 15 April 2026.

STYLE: professional business look, consistent color scheme (e.g. modern_blue), readable font sizes, no text overflowing the slide. Keep each slide's bullets concise enough to fit.

DELIVERABLE / ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
1. The file exists at the exact path above.
2. Exactly 5 slides with the exact titles specified.
3. Slide 2 contains a real table (not just text) with all 12 months, their order counts and revenues matching the data above.
4. Return in your final message: the absolute file path, the slide count, and a short confirmation of the table contents (months + numbers) so it can be verified without re-opening the file.

Do not create any other files or send any emails. Only produce the .pptx.
Build Monthly_Sales_Review.pptx

Create one Google Calendar event using the `mcp__google_calendar__create_event` tool. Do not create anything else, do not send emails, do not create recurring events.

EVENT SPECIFICATION (exact):
- summary / title: "Monthly Sales Review"
- start: 2026-04-15 at 14:00 (local time) — pass dateTime "2026-04-15T14:00:00"
- end: 2026-04-15 at 15:00 — pass dateTime "2026-04-15T15:00:00"
- description: must clearly note that it is a stakeholder review of monthly sales performance. Use something like: "Stakeholder review of monthly sales performance. Agenda: monthly revenue overview, order volume trends, key insights and next steps for improving sales performance. Presentation: Monthly_Sales_Review.pptx."

Use the date-times exactly as given (a 1-hour event on 2026-04-15 from 14:00 to 15:00). Do not add attendees.

DELIVERABLE: report back the created event's ID, its exact title, and its start/end times as confirmation.
